subject: Coordinating multi-timezone enablement block + fallback plan
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finplux.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@finplux.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood enablement — preferred days and constraints

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — FinPlux is keen to move to a short enablement block next month so our devs can get keys, test the console, and run an API deep-dive. We need a compact plan because a chunk of our engineering team will be traveling during the first week of December.

Constraints:
- Prefer a 4-hour block on a single day (ideally split into 2h API + 2h Console).
- Timezone: core team in IST (UTC+5:30); a few stakeholders in PST.
- We need the API deep-dive earlier in the day (per our infra lead).

Any chance you can propose a few slots and a backup plan if someone drops off last-minute? Also, please include any prep checklist we should circulate.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform
FinPlux

Attachments: none
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finplux.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@finplux.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood enablement — preferred days and constraints

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear constraints. Looping in Camila (SE) and Monica (Onboarding Ops) so we can draft a compact plan and drop calendar invites.

Quick proposal (all times shown in both PST / IST):
- Option A (single-day split):
  - 08:00–10:00 PST / 21:30–23:30 IST — API deep-dive (demos + sample integration)
  - 10:30–12:30 PST / 00:00–02:00 IST — Console walkthrough + Q&A
- Option B (morning only shorter):
  - 09:00–12:00 PST / 22:30–01:30 IST — condensed API + console highlights
- Backup: 2-hour follow-up office hours the next day (flexible window) for any sticky items.

Prep checklist (high level):
- Confirm list of attendees + roles (infra, app dev, SRE).
- Add dev keys for a sandbox project (we can provision beforehand).
- Sample prompts or API calls you want to prioritize.

Attachments: enablement-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB) — initial runbook and checklist.

Camila / Monica — can you confirm feasibility of Option A vs B and whether the backup office hours work?

Best,
Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finplux.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@finplux.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood enablement — preferred days and constraints

Thanks Logan — Option A looks good, but two notes:
1) Our infra lead insists the API deep-dive be first and run for a full 2 hours (no rush).
2) A few engineers have strict travel windows that day and may drop between 22:45–23:15 IST. We need a robust fallback: either a short recording + timestamped notes or a shadow seat from your side we can land questions to asynchronously.

Can you also add your security contact to the thread? We have a quick list of compliance questions (SOC2 evidence + data handling) to cover briefly.

Sanjay

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finplux.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@finplux.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood enablement — proposed plan + backup options

Hey team — happy to run the API deep-dive. Quick operational notes and a compact fallback playbook: 

Operational notes:
- We can staff a SE + engineer shadow for the primary session and rotate in a second SE for the console portion.
- We'll record the API deep-dive and upload a segmented recording with timestamps within 2 hours of session end.
- If an attendee drops during the API window (22:45–23:15 IST), our SE will mark the timeline and we will schedule a 30-min follow-up sync for any missed Qs.

Compact fallback playbook:
1) Primary: run full Option A as proposed.
2) If >20% attendee drop at any point, immediately pause to capture remaining questions in the chat.
3) Post-session: upload recording + 3 bullet timestamps and publish to the shared Drive folder.
4) Book 30-min office hours next day as automatic fallback.

Shared links: enablement checklist (Drive) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBex-example-runbook

Attachments: console-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB) — day-of run order and roles.

Monica — can you pre-provision a sandbox project and dev keys for FinPlux by EOD Friday if they confirm Option A?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Subject: Final: Confirming Option A + invites to follow

Sanjay / Elena — thanks for the quick responses. We’ll lock Option A on 2026-12-10 (08:00–12:30 PST / 21:30–02:00 IST) with the split as discussed (API first).

Action items I’ll own:
- Send calendar invites with Zoom + agenda (by EOD today).
- Publish MAP in HubSpot (HS-Deal-12345) with session acceptance as milestone.
- Confirm sandbox provisioning update (Monica) and SE staffing (Camila).

Camila / Monica — please add the recording plan and office-hours fallback to the invite so the FinPlux team sees the contingency plan.

Logan
